entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Fix keyboard timing on layout containers with SafeArea #33142
  • BackButtonBehavior not bound #33139
  • .NET MAUI 9 TitleBar Spacing Issue #33137
  • TitleBar Content Overlapping with Traffic Light Buttons on Latest macOS Version #33136
  • [iOS] LargeTitles deferred loading until user interacted with content #33135
  • Implement Material3 Support for Switch Control #33131
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • [NET 10] I6_Grouping - Grouping_with_variable_sized_items changing the 'ItemSizingStrategy' also changes the header size. #33130

Closed

  • [Android] Add support for "Go To Disassembly" when debugging .NET MAUI Android apps in Visual Studio #33104
  • Editor.Text not getting value on code behind only in iOS 18.6 release mode in REAL DEVICES #33116
  • Proposal: Blazor Native – Razor-based declarative UI with native rendering (no XAML, no WebView) #33126
  • MAC - VSC - ILLink.Task - doesnt make build #33020
  • CI artifact error: uitest-snapshot-results-android-Job19-1 already exists for build #33026
  • [MAUI]I1_Layout-Vertical list and Grid content cannot adapt when the window is reduced #23702
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • FontImageSource not rendering on MacCatalyst #32969
  • App crash only on release if use FormattedText of Label component in .xaml #32934

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix Picker layout on Mac Catalyst 26+ #33146
    platform/macos, area-controls-picker, version/iOS-26
  • Extract Issue32041 testing files from PR #32405 #33145
  • Extract Issue28986 test changes from PR #32405 #33144
  • Refactor image rotation and PNG format logic #33140
    community ✨
  • [Android] Fixed EmptyView doesn’t display when CollectionView is placed inside a VerticalStackLayout #33134
    platform/android, area-controls-collectionview, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Android] Fix WebView scrolling inside ScrollView #33133
    platform/android, community ✨, area-controls-webview, partner/syncfusion
  • [Android] Implemented Material3 Support for Switch Control #33132
    platform/android, community ✨, area-controls-switch, partner/syncfusion
  • Fix command dependency reentrancy #33129
  • Fix for Control does not update from binding anymore after MultiBinding.ConvertBack is called #33128
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Improved Unfocus support for Picker on Mac Catalyst #33127
    platform/macos, area-controls-picker, t/a11y

Merged

  • Fix HostBuilderHandlerTests for net11.0 IMauiContext parameter requirement #33138
  • [ci] Update arcade on main #33100
  • Avoid UITest snapshot artifact name collisions across stages #33122
  • [ci] Don t batch runs on public ci #33120
    area-infrastructure
  • [ci] Fixes to net10.0 branch #33124

Updated

  • [net11] Update versions dotnet/ios/android #33075
    area-infrastructure, .NET 11 Planning
  • [net11.0] Use ElementHandlerAttribute instead of DI for built-in visual elements #29952
    platform/macos, platform/windows, platform/android, platform/ios, area-architecture, .NET 11 Planning
  • [testing] dotnet test for maui #33117
    t/enhancement ☀️, area-testing
  • [Android] Implemented `UseMaterial3` build property and provided basic M3 styles #33074
    platform/android, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • Fix keyboard overlap on Android when SoftInput.AdjustResize is set #32405
    p/0, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Android] Fix for App Hang When PopModalAsync Is Called Immediately After PushModalAsync with Task.Yield() #32479
    p/0, community ✨, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR3
  • Add PR-based UITest category detection and gating #33121
  • Fix the Aspire ServiceDefaults project template #33025
  • [Android] Image control crashes on Android when image width exceeds height #33045
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [windows] Fixed Rapid change of selected tab results in crash. #33113
    platform/windows, area-controls-tabbedpage, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Testing] Feature Matrix UITest Cases for BindableLayout #33108
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [Windows] Fix Shell title bar overlap with window controls in RTL mode #33109
    platform/windows, area-controls-shell, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
